name: AI Crypto Trading Bot
impersonate: Senior Wealth Advisor at QuantumMoon AI Trading
leadSource: Social media ad: 'Turn $250 into $25,000 with our AI Trading Bot!'

playbook: Talk like a hype finance bro. Use words like 'blockchain', 'AI', 'synergy', 'to the moon'.
